description.title: הארכת תקופת תביעה
description.summary: This table outlines the process for re-evaluating long-term care claims exceeding 3 months. It details the conditions under which Harel will re-examine an insured's medical and functional condition to determine continued eligibility for benefits.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תהליך הערכה מחדש של תביעות סיעוד הנמשכות יותר מ-3 חודשים. הראל תבחן מחדש את מצבו הרפואי והתפקודי של המבוטח כדי לקבוע זכאות מתמשכת להטבות, תוך התחשבות בגיל המבוטח ובמידע רפואי עדכני. תהליך זה רלוונטי במיוחד עבור פוליסת 'מושלם סיעוד' של חברי כללית. אי שיתוף פעולה או אי הגשת מסמכים בזמן עלולים להוביל להפסקת תשלום ההטבות. הראל שומרת לעצמה את הזכות לבצע בדיקה מחודשת של הזכאות במידת הצורך, גם אם הזכאות אושרה לתקופה מוגדרת מראש. תביעה לתקופה מאושרת מעל 3 חודשים מחייבת הערכה מחודשת.
notable_values: failure to cooperate: may result in termination of benefits
re-examination: may be conducted via medical documents or professional examination

sketch:
Claim for an approved period - for a period exceeding 3 months
Approval of a periodic claim for additional defned periods beyond the approved period, shall require - at the end of the period approved for payment - re-examination of the insured's medical and functional condition.
Upon re-examination of the liability and its performance, the insured's medical condition, age, the information provided to the company and the policy conditions shall be taken into account, inter alia.
The re-eligibility examination may be performed, inter alia, in accordance with the insured's condition and age by way of inspection of current medical documents regarding the insured's medical or functional condition, or by having the insured examined by appropriate professionals on behalf of Harel.
Towards the end of the eligibility period, Harel shall approach you for the purpose of conducting the re-eligibility examination. As part of this approach, you may be required to submit to Harel current medical documents or to schedule an examination to assess your current functional and medical condition, in the framework of the times noted in the request.
Failure to provide the requested documents timeously and/or non-cooperation regarding an examination by an appropriate professional determined by Harel in a timely manner may result in termination of payment of insurance benefts or delay in payment thereof.
Harel reserves the right to conduct a re-examination of your eligibility if necessary, even in cases where the insured's eligibility is confrmed for a predetermined period and during the period information is received by Harel which differs from that provided by the insured and/ or which was known to Harel and indicates that the insured may have ceased to be eligible for insurance benefts.
